_meta.purpose: LOW-2 real-sample gate (cv-b-fk-08o, decision 6 / fk-4xq): pins the classifier in con-voyage-pr-watch.sh to REAL `gc github pr backfill --json` enum values instead of strings-recovered guesses.
_meta.captured_via: gc --city /Users/kris/repl-city github pr backfill --json  (REPORT-ONLY: no --create-repair-beads; zero beads created, zero mutation)
_meta.sanitization: title/head_ref_name/url/head_sha/number replaced with placeholders below (real PR content is not needed to pin the schema); owner/repo/rig/repair_route left as-is (already used as example data throughout this test suite) since only state/failure_kind/merge_state_status/actionable/failed_checks/pending_checks are load-bearing for the classifier.
findings: gc emits `failure_kind` directly on every result, using exactly the locked vocabulary: checks_failed | merge_conflict | blocked (confirmed live). behind_base was NOT observed live in this sample -- no monitored PR was in that state at capture time -- but it is produced by the same gc mechanism (same field, same vocabulary), just unconfirmed by a live sample.

`state` values observed do NOT match the design doc's strings-recovered guess: real values seen were `conflicted` (not `dirty`), `failed` (not a bare failed_checks[]-only signal), and `blocked` -- confirming the PRIMARY (trust-gc failure_kind) classification path is the one that matters live, with state/failed_checks as fallback only.

`checks_failed` results can carry pending_checks alongside failed_checks (a PR can be simultaneously failing one check and still running others) -- the classifier must not require pending_checks to be empty.

samples.combo: actionable=true, state=failed, failure_kind=checks_failed, merge_state_status=DIRTY, failed_checks non-empty, pending_checks non-empty
actionable=true, state=failed, failure_kind=checks_failed, merge_state_status=DIRTY, failed_checks non-empty, no pending_checks
actionable=true, state=failed, failure_kind=checks_failed, merge_state_status=BLOCKED, failed_checks non-empty, no pending_checks

not_observed_live.behind_base: No monitored PR was in the BEHIND state at capture time. Same gc mechanism (failure_kind field, same vocabulary) is expected to produce it, but this specific value is unconfirmed by a live sample as of this capture.
